bugs.title: run_llama_bench crashes on every invocation
bugs.description: The command never requests JSON output, so llama-bench emits markdown. json.loads(out) runs outside the try block, causing an uncaught JSONDecodeError that kills --llama-bench mode entirely. Two failure modes are complementary: models with server-only extras fail at argv parsing (graceful), while clean extras reach json.loads on markdown output (crash). The crash path also aborts any pending --run.
bugs.fix: Add -o json flag to cmd; move json.loads inside try block; insert failed row on error

bugs.title: Mid-run server death stamps wrong hash on failed rows
bugs.description: In benchmark_model, the crash handler uses config_hash=chashes[pid] (the prompt where death was noticed) for all remaining prompts pid2, while correctly setting prompt_id=pid2. This produces rows where config_hash and prompt_id are inconsistent — exactly the kind of provenance corruption the schema was designed to prevent.

bugs.title: Literal backslash-n in build_padded contaminates every padded prompt
bugs.description: The string '\\n' is two characters (backslash + n), not a newline. Every padded benchmark prompt has this artifact glued between filler and instruction, unlike the rest of the file which uses real newlines.

bugs.title: Spec-acceptance attributed to wrong request under --quality
bugs.description: In measure_cell, spec_accept_from_log runs after needle_test and takes the LAST n_accept/n_predict in the log. With --quality, the last logged request is the 24-token needle retrieval over filler — not the 200-token code generation being measured. lfm-8b is the only spec-decoding model, so this poisons exactly the rows the feature exists to characterize, silently.
bugs.fix: Move spec_accept_from_log before needle_test so it captures the measured request's log

bugs.title: Harness code itself is not in config_hash
bugs.description: config_hash covers binary, build, model mtime, flags, prompt, fill — nothing identifies the harness itself. Editing _VOCAB, filler_text, chat() TTFT definition, or any methodology constant changes no hash, so has_ok skips re-measuring rows that should be invalidated. A HARNESS_VERSION/SCRIPT_VERSION constant in the key closes this class.
bugs.fix: Add script/harness version constant to config_hash key

bugs.title: --history silently drops --json flag
bugs.description: report(db, history=True, model=...) never passes as_json=args.json, so requesting JSON output while in history mode silently falls back to table format.

bugs.title: ensure_columns strips ts default during ALTER, causing NULL timestamps on migrated DBs
bugs.description: d.split(' DEFAULT (')[0] reduces ts to bare TEXT, but insert_run never supplies ts. On v2-A/v2-B tables upgraded via ADD COLUMN, every subsequently inserted row has ts IS NULL.

bugs.title: cfg['extra'] forwarded verbatim to llama-bench and llama-perplexity
bugs.description: Server-only flags like --spec-type ngram-mod and --reasoning auto are not accepted by those tools, causing --llama-bench to error for lfm-8b and --ppl to silently yield no comparison.
bugs.fix: Split into extra_server vs extra_common or filter per tool; use extra_bench key in MODELS

bugs.title: run_llama_bench and run_ppl failures leave no status='failed' rows
bugs.description: The harness path writes failures as data; the other two modes print and vanish. run_ppl is worse: subprocess.run(...).stdout without a returncode check means an unknown-flag abort produces 'could not parse perplexity' and zero DB rows — a --ppl run that did nothing looks identical to one never attempted.
bugs.fix: Add failed row inserts for llama-bench and ppl error paths

bugs.title: Missing binary crashes the whole run
bugs.description: Model files are existence-checked; binaries aren't. Popen sits before the try block, so a missing llama-server raises FileNotFoundError past the finally (leaking log) and aborts remaining models with a traceback.
bugs.fix: Wrap Popen in try/except OSError; close log; insert failed rows for remaining prompts

bugs.title: chat() has no total deadline
bugs.description: urlopen(timeout=...) is per-read; a stalled stream hangs forever. With default --timeout 600, a 131k-ctx padded prompt at ~200 t/s pp alone exceeds the budget — those cells will all record failed.
bugs.fix: Track wall-clock deadline; raise TimeoutError if exceeded

bugs.title: latest_runs view hides failures from default report
bugs.description: The view filters WHERE status='ok', so a config whose latest attempts all crash silently vanishes from the default report. The 'FAILED'.rjust(18) branch is dead code on that path — the opposite of the schema's stated intent 'failures are data'.
bugs.fix: Remove status='ok' filter from latest_runs view, or add footer listing failed configs

bugs.title: Legacy VRAM relabeled, not measured
bugs.description: migrate_legacy maps v1's vram_mib into vram_delta_mib. v3 defines delta precisely (used minus pre-start baseline); v1 recorded a single number of uncertain semantics. Writing it into the precisely-defined column asserts provenance the data can't support.
bugs.fix: Map to vram_abs_mib or document in migration comment

bugs.title: Alternate llama-bench schema drops tg values
bugs.description: In the ks fallback for alternate schema, ks[0][:-4] imports only the first pp*/tg* key per row — if pp and tg share one dict, tg is silently lost.
bugs.fix: Iterate all matching keys; factor row-emit into a helper function

bugs.title: Requested ctx beyond max_ctx vanishes silently
bugs.description: model_ctxs filters it out of the plan loop, so --ctx 131072 on lfm-8b produces no row, no skip line, no failed row — a user asked for a measurement and got nothing.
bugs.fix: Print skip message when ctx exceeds model max_ctx

bugs.title: --quality is fragile to cell order
bugs.description: run_needle=args.quality and i == 0: if the first prompt's cell throws, no needle runs for that ctx even though later prompts measured fine. Decouple needle execution from prompt index.
bugs.fix: Track needle_done per (name, ctx) rather than i == 0

bugs.title: Reasoning models distort TTFT/tg fallback
bugs.description: vibethinker-3b streams reasoning_content deltas; chat() ignores them, so TTFT measures first visible content and wall-clock tg fallback undercounts whenever server timings are absent.
bugs.fix: Include reasoning_content in delta extraction for TTFT; flag reasoning rows in notes

provenance_gaps.title: --lock-clocks and --repeats absent from config_hash
provenance_gaps.description: A locked-clock run will has_ok-match an unlocked run and be skipped. Median-of-1 and median-of-3 share a hash despite llama-bench's extra_key including repeats. Same for GPU identity — swap GPUs and old rows are trusted.
provenance_gaps.fix: Add clocks_mhz, repeats, and gpu_name to hash

provenance_gaps.title: flags field overclaims for non-harness modes
provenance_gaps.description: Every hash embeds 'ngl99,fa-on,jinja,no-context-shift,t8,tb16' but run_ppl passes none of these, llama-bench never sees t/tb/jinja/no-context-shift, and fill/max_tokens leak into lb/ppl hashes. Make the flags string mode-specific.
provenance_gaps.fix: Mode-specific flags in config_hash; use mode parameter

provenance_gaps.title: Needle gate partially self-defeating
provenance_gaps.description: NEEDLE_WORDS ∩ _VOCAB = {vector, tundra}. Two of ten secrets are partially camouflaged by filler distractors, and make_secret() uses unseeded global random so misses aren't reproducible.
provenance_gaps.fix: Disjoint the two lists; seed the RNG; record secret in notes for auditability

provenance_gaps.title: Clock-lock state not in config_hash
provenance_gaps.description: Measure once unlocked, and every later --run --lock-clocks skips all cells as already measured. gpu_clock_sm lets you see the regime after the fact but skip logic cannot distinguish them.
provenance_gaps.fix: Add 'clocks': args.lock_clocks to hash key (covered by #18 above)

additional_issues.title: Needle secret not recorded in notes
additional_issues.description: Only pass/fail is stored; stashing the secret in notes would make misses auditable.

additional_issues.title: ClockLock resets on exception but not SIGKILL
additional_issues.description: The help text 'ALWAYS reset on exit' oversells the guarantee. Also locks only core clock, not memory clock.

additional_issues.title: File naming irony
additional_issues.description: File is benchmark_v2.py but docstring says v3.

additional_issues.title: print interleaving in measure_cell
additional_issues.description: print(f'\n      {summary}') inside measure_cell interleaves oddly with the unlabeled result line that follows (cosmetic).
